Subject: MSA + Order Form — final redline for sign-off

Team — thanks for the fast turnaround on the redlines. Attached is Helios' consolidated MSA redline (MSA_Redline_Helios_v6.docx). A couple of outstanding items from our side before we can route for signature: 

- Data residency clause: we accepted Redwood's suggested language but would like a one-sentence carve for audit data (see para 5.2). Can Redwood legal confirm that's acceptable?
- Order Form signatory: our purchasing requires an authorized signatory from the US operating entity (Emily Chen, CFO). We need confirmation this is fine from your side (no cross-entity execution issues).

DocuSign logistics: we prefer sequential routing so our CFO signs last, and we'd like an audit trail / access-code option. Also, do you require witnesses or notarization for the Order Form (Helios does not expect notarization but can provide a witness if required).

Please advise on the final steps so we can lock the envelope and schedule execution next week.

Thanks,
Laura McKenna
VP, Business Ops
Helios Labs

Date: Sun, Apr 11, 2027 at 10:05 AM PDT
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form — final redline for sign-off

Hi Laura — appreciate the clear list. Quick plan from our side: 

1) Legal check: looping in Karthik to confirm the data residency carve. He'll call out any remaining language tweaks required for our compliance team.
2) Signer authority: Ben, can you confirm we have no objection to the Helios US entity (Emily Chen) signing the Order Form? If so we will allow cross-entity execution for the Order Form only and produce a short execution certificate.
3) DocuSign flow: propose a sequential envelope (Redwood exec -> Helios legal -> Helios CFO). We'll enable access-code verification for the CFO step. If Helios prefers parallel routing for speed, flag now — sequential is preferred to preserve signature order and timestamping.
4) Clean copy: once legal confirms redline acceptance, Karthik will generate MSA_Final_v7.pdf and a clean order form; Soojin will prepare the final artifact package and upload to the shared Drive folder.

I've attached our execution guidance (Redwood_Execution_Guidance.pdf) — it's short and shows the envelope settings we typically use. Karthik — can you review para 5 re: audit log retention? Soojin — please reserve a DocuSign envelope slot for Wed morning and draft a short execution checklist.

If everyone agrees I will reply-all with the final signer list and requested contact emails so Helios can confirm.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Partnerships Ops
Redwood Inference

Laura / Irene — confirmed from the commercial side: Helios' approach is fine. We have no issue with Emily Chen (CFO, Helios Labs US) signing the Order Form. Two quick asks from Redwood: 

- Please provide Emily's full name, title, and the direct email to which the DocuSign envelope should be sent.
- We prefer the CFO step to use an access code (shared by Helios legal in a separate channel) rather than embedded signing for execs. That avoids session-timeout issues.

We are good with sequential routing as long as the envelope settings include: recipient authentication (access code), disable auto-correct on signature fields, and allow for a single re-assignment if Emily is out of office. I attached the current OrderForm_Clean_DRAFT.pdf for reference — we'll swap to the final version once legal signs off.

Thanks — I'll stand by to confirm final signer list.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

All — quick legal clearance note after reviewing Helios' MSA_Redline_Helios_v6.docx: 

- Data residency: the carve for audit data in 5.2 is acceptable provided Helios confirms retention window (standard 90 days). If Helios is ok, Karthik will incorporate the sentence and produce MSA_Final_v7.pdf.
- Cross-entity signing: we are comfortable permitting the Helios US entity (Emily Chen) to sign the Order Form provided Helios provides a brief execution certificate (one paragraph) confirming signatory authority.

Execution settings we will use (to be encoded in the envelope):
- Routing: sequential (Redwood exec -> Helios legal -> Helios CFO)
- Recipient authentication: access code for the CFO step (shared out-of-band)
- Signature options: standard DocuSign signature; disable auto-correct; require name and title fields
- Audit: full DocuSign audit log retained and appended to final PDFs

Soojin will stage the envelope tomorrow morning and attach the final PDFs. Please reply-all with Emily Chen's email and phone number (for the access-code SMS fallback) if you want us to set SMS as a secondary auth. Once we have that, I'll publish MSA_Final_v7.pdf and the clean Order Form and then mark the thread for sign-off.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
